policy: Source-backed tool identities are reviewed against current routing, privacy boundaries, engine reuse and distinct end-user intent. Review does not publish or index a candidate.

records.reason: The route is a substantive developer/reference surface, not a distinct end-user task. It intentionally remains noindex and excluded from the public tool launcher/count.
The compatibility route resolves into a private user-state surface. Publishing it as a separate public task would cross the private/public boundary and duplicate existing share-card behavior.
Current routing already resolves diaspora behavior to the canonical clock/timezone task. A second public tool page would duplicate the same engine and intent.

The compatibility route enters private reminder state while the distinct public reminder task already exists at /tools/tithi-reminder. Promoting /tools/tithi would duplicate intent and risk private-state leakage.
